item.summary: fix: keep background work scoped to its selected agent (#123257) * fix: preserve explicit agent ownership Scoped route, session, and job owners now survive hooks, cron, process exits, global delivery, bindings, and media cleanup. Truly ownerless operations remain explicit errors. * test: provide session memory hook owner * test(ui): close failed-module page explicitly * test(matrix): align ownership and replacement proof
